title: Perfect Rectangle
description: Determine if a collection of rectangles forms a perfect rectangle covering a single area without gaps or overlaps.
pseudocode:
1: corners = new Set()
2: area = 0
3: minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity
4: for each rect in rectangles:
5:   area += (x2-x1)*(y2-y1)
6:   minX = min(minX, x1), minY = min(minY, y1), maxX = max(maxX, x2), maxY = max(maxY, y2)
7:   toggle corner in set (x1,y1), (x1,y2), (x2,y1), (x2,y2)
8: return area == (maxX-minX)*(maxY-minY) && corners.size == 4

steps.note: Initialize boundaries and total area calculation.
Toggling corners of first rectangle into the set.
Calculating area of second rectangle: 1*1 = 1, total area = 2.
Checking if total area matches bounding box and only 4 unique corners remain.
